notes: מֵאֹתוֹ is tagged מִן + object marker (To) + suffix exactly as in 18.6, where the chapter gives the preposition to מִן and leaves the marker unrepresented; here the same string was fused into one unit by. Rule 16 gives an H853 marker English only where no other morpheme licenses the word, and מִן licenses by, so the marker is its own unrepresented unit and מִן takes by alone, matching 18.6.
